town.rename.label: Settlement name
town.tier.specLater: At the final stage you will choose a specialisation.
town.tier.max: Your settlement has reached the top stage. Well done!
town.arrival.ok: Homes are ready – new families arrive at {hour}.
town.arrival.housing: No one will come: there are no free beds.
town.arrival.unhappy: No one will come: residents are too unhappy (below 45%).
town.arrival.hungry: No one will come: the pantry is short of food.
town.arrival.jobs: No one will come: too many residents are looking for work – build new workplaces.
town.foodDetail: {n} nutrition points, the settlement eats {daily} a day
town.foodNobody: Food in the pantry will feed future residents.
town.storageNote: Food goes to the pantry and takes no storage space.
town.storageFull: Storage is full – workshops and lumberjacks have stopped (food still goes to the pantry). Build a warehouse or sell the surplus.
town.event.fire.desc: The fire is damaging the building. A fire station puts it out within an hour; a well slows the flames.
town.event.breakdown.desc: The building is idle. Builders will fix it, or you can pay for a quick repair.
town.event.epidemic.desc: Sick animals produce nothing. A clinic or medicine cures them faster.
town.event.crisis.desc: Prices at the market and from caravans are 30% lower.
town.territory.full: You can't buy more land at this stage.
town.spec.title: Specialisation
town.spec.once: You can choose only once, for the rest of the game.
town.spec.agri.desc: Fields, mills and bakeries yield 25% more food.
town.spec.trade.desc: Caravans come every day and pay 25% more.
town.spec.craft.desc: The sawmill, workshop and loom work 25% faster, and tools give +20%.
town.res.empty: The settlement is waiting for its first residents.
town.res.emptyHint: Put up a tent or a hut – families arrive every day at 9:00.
town.res.none.homeless: Everyone has a roof over their head!
town.budget.noHistory: The budget history appears after the settlement's first day.
town.reserve.hint: Residents won't eat reserved food and caravans won't buy it automatically.
town.reserve.none: The pantry is empty right now.
town.council.empty: No proposals today. The council meets every morning.
town.council.tooSmall: The council will meet once the settlement grows a little.
town.council.hallHint: The council meets in the town hall and gives a 10% building discount.
town.council.about: Approving cheers the supporters up (+5% happiness for a day); rejecting saddens them a little.
town.effect.policy: If approved: tax drops by {value} points
town.proposal.need_well.desc: We carry water from afar. A well makes nearby homes cosier.
town.proposal.need_food.desc: Tummies are rumbling. A settlement field gives steady harvests.
town.proposal.need_bakery.desc: Bread is the most filling – let a baker bake it from flour.
town.proposal.need_housing.desc: It's getting crowded. A house will fit more families.
town.proposal.need_warehouse.desc: Storage is bursting at the seams and workshops have stopped.
town.proposal.need_school.desc: Children are bored without lessons. A school cheers them up and helps adults work better.
town.proposal.need_plaza.desc: There's nowhere to unwind after work. A plaza adds some fun.
town.proposal.need_lights.desc: It's so dark after nightfall. Lanterns make people feel safer.
town.proposal.need_police.desc: Residents don't feel safe. Guards also calm quarrels.
town.proposal.need_clinic.desc: Animals are falling ill. A medic cures them in a day.
town.proposal.need_trade.desc: We want to trade with our neighbours. A trading post brings caravans.
town.proposal.lower_taxes.desc: Taxes weigh us down – we ask for relief.
town.proposal.festival.desc: Let's throw a fair with music and dancing!
town.proposal.tools_grant.desc: Craftsmen could use new tools – work will go faster.
town.proposal.roads.desc: It's hard to get to work. A road links homes and workshops.
town.trade.buysNone: {price} each · up to {qty} · you have none
town.trade.buysInfo: {price} each · you have {have} · buys up to {qty}
town.trade.nothing: The caravan isn't looking for anything today.
town.trade.noPost: Caravans visit a trading post. Build one to trade with your neighbours.
town.trade.noPostTier: You can build a trading post at the “{tier}” stage – then caravans will start to arrive.
town.trade.postIdle: The trading post needs a merchant. Caravans will come once someone works there.
town.trade.soon: A caravan will set off soon.
town.export.hint: Ticked goods are sold to every caravan ({n} are kept in reserve).
town.chronicle.empty: The chronicle is still empty. The first entry is coming soon!
chronicle.born.plain: A baby was born in the settlement!
chronicle.grewUp: {name} has grown up and can now work.
chronicle.grewUp.plain: One of the children has grown up.
chronicle.wedding: A wedding! {a} and {b} are now a family.
chronicle.wedding.plain: There was a wedding in the settlement!
chronicle.quarrel: A quarrel: {a} and {b} can't get along.
chronicle.love.plain: Someone in the settlement fell in love.
chronicle.territory: The settlement expanded its land (cost: {cost} coins).
chronicle.tierUp.plain: The settlement reached a new stage!
chronicle.unpaid: {missing} coins short for wages – workers are disappointed.
chronicle.unpaid.plain: There were not enough coins for wages.
chronicle.renamed: The settlement has a new name: {name}.
chronicle.renamed.plain: The settlement has a new name.
chronicle.fire.spread: The fire spread to a neighbouring building: {building}!
chronicle.fireOut.damaged: The fire is out – {building} needs repairs.
chronicle.epidemic: Animals are sick: {building} – it will last {days}.
chronicle.goodEvent.festival: Travelling musicians arrived – it's a fair!
chronicle.goodEvent.harvest: Bumper harvest! Work is going swimmingly.
chronicle.goodEvent.richCaravan: Word is that a wealthy caravan is on its way.
chronicle.festival: Travelling musicians arrived – it's a fair!
chronicle.harvest: Bumper harvest! Work is going swimmingly.
chronicle.richCaravan: Word is that a wealthy caravan is on its way.
chronicle.eventOver.crisis: The slump is over – prices are back to normal.
chronicle.eventOver.festival: The fair is over – the musicians have moved on.
chronicle.eventOver.harvest: The bumper harvest is over; work is back to its usual pace.
chronicle.traded.export: Sold {qty} × {item} to the caravan for {coins} coins.
chronicle.traded.import: Bought {qty} × {item} from the caravan for {coins} coins.
chronicle.traded.plain: A good deal with the caravan.
chronicle.proposal.plain: The council made a new proposal.
resident.title: Resident
resident.gone: This resident is no longer in the settlement.
resident.moodUp: In a better mood for now ({v}% until day {day})
resident.moodDown: In a worse mood for now ({v}% until day {day})
resident.sadDays: Unhappy for {days} – may leave after 3 days.
resident.homelessDays: Homeless for {days} – may leave after 2 days.
resident.noRelations: No close ties yet – friendships grow at work and between neighbours.
resident.hint.food.stock: The pantry is short of food – harvest crops or build a settlement field.
resident.hint.food.variety: Meals are modest – provide more kinds of food.
resident.hint.housing.none: Needs a home with a free bed.
resident.hint.housing.better: A better home, such as a house or townhouse, is cosier.
resident.hint.work.homeless: Can't find work without a home.
resident.hint.work.noJobs: No open jobs – build a new workplace.
resident.hint.work.commute: Can't reach the open jobs – connect home and work with a road.
resident.hint.fun.deco: Decorations near home lift the mood.
